# Golden schema-v1 project fixtures

These `.voxora` files were generated by the UNMODIFIED Phase 1-8 serializer
(`app/projects/serializer.py`, schema_version 1) and are used by
`tests/test_project_characterization.py` (and, from Phase 1 Step 3, the
v1 -> v2 migration tests).

* `v1_minimal.voxora`       - empty project
* `v1_full.voxora`          - 4 scenes (English / Bengali / mixed), all Phase 4 per-scene
                              overrides, studio settings with music + video, Windows paths
                              with spaces and Bengali
* `v1_phase3_legacy.voxora` - hand-written Phase 3-era file: no `schema_version`, no
                              `settings`, no Phase 4 scene keys
* `v1_unknown_keys.voxora`  - v1 file with extra top-level and scene keys (today they are
                              dropped on load)

RULES: never regenerate these with newer code and never edit them to make a test pass.
If the file format changes, ADD new fixtures (v2_*.voxora); keep these as proof that old
files still open.
